text:
The builder will likely recover only $3,000, the amount by which the partially built greenhouse increased the homeowner's property value, under restitution/quasi-contract principles when the contract is unenforceable or breached before completion. The builder cannot recover expectation damages because the breach prevented completion, and his costs ($10,000) and material resale offset do not set the measure here. Thus, recovery is limited to the benefit conferred on the homeowner.

CONFIDENCE: 55
